about.headline: You picture the house. We build it to last.
about.body: Most homeowners want the same things from a contractor: a fair price in writing, quality work from everyone on the crew, and someone who stays in touch until the job is done. Every project is run that way, from a few windows to a full addition.

realReviews.author: Dan Dobrick
realReviews.text: Joe recently completed a big project for us: adding a 250 sq. ft. porch on our house.  It’s turned out so beautiful!  We really are very impressed, not only with the quality of his work, but also the excellent quality produced by the people he hires.  Yes, you can get both high quality and reasonable price!

realReviews.author: Dave McNary
realReviews.text:
We hired Joe to renovate the front of our house. A new front door, remodeled porch with decking and post wrap. We also had new gutters with leaf guards, new shutters, painted garage doors and side doors as well as a few windows. Joe did a great job taking our vision and making it a reality. Easy to work with, open to change orders and quality work. We would not hesitate to work again with JD Construction.

Dave and Bonnie

realReviews.author: Holly Kimmes
realReviews.text: JD construction was wonderful to work with!  I hired Joe for window replacement,  interior door replacement,  as well as siding projects.  The window replacement cost was almost half of what a larger company quoted me!  He really goes above and beyond to make sure the job is completed as you desire.

faq.q: Can I make changes once the job starts?
faq.a: Yes. Change orders are talked through and priced openly, so you always know where the project stands.

faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the project.
